subject: MAP & eval playbook kickoff for Cynergy AI — confirm goals and timeline
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP & eval playbook kickoff for Cynergy AI — confirm goals and timeline

Hi Ethan —

Great to meet you on Friday. I wanted to kick off the mutual action plan (MAP) and the evaluation playbook so we can lock a short, focused timeline and clear owners. I attached an initial MAP workbook (Cynergy-MAP-20260112.xlsx) with a proposed 2-week evaluation window followed by a 1-week procurement path. High-level goals I have captured: 

- Success criteria: 95th pctile latency < 300ms for 512 tokens, and feature parity on embeddings for semantic search.
- Evaluation scope: hosted Redwood API trial, embedding accuracy checks, and a small end-to-end proof-of-concept using your ingest pipeline.
- Timeline (proposed):
  * Week 1 (Jan 19–23): model evaluation + integration smoke tests
  * Week 2 (Jan 26–30): performance tuning, QA, and SLO verification
  * Procurement & rollout planning: first two business days of Feb

Questions for you: who should be listed as the primary champion(s) and procurement contact at Cynergy? Are there any pre-existing security questionnaires or SSO/KMS constraints we should know about up front?

I'd like to propose a 30-minute kickoff on Thu Jan 14 to review the MAP, confirm attendees, and agree on next steps. I have availability 11:00–11:45 AM PT or 2:00–2:30 PM PT — which works better?

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks — that plan looks sensible. I'll be the primary champion on our side. I'm looping Priya (data platform lead) and Liu (security/infra) into the kickoff — they should be the right folks for integration and KMS/SSO conversations. Procurement runs through procurement@cynergy.ai (I've CC'd an alias).

11:00 AM PT on Thu Jan 14 works for us. Please send a calendar invite. Quick notes:
- We have an internal requirement to review crypto key management for any private deployment (Liu will outline specifics).
- For the eval, Priya will want a short test dataset (~10k records) and a list of KPIs to validate embedding quality.

Grace / Karthik —

Quick internal note ahead of Thu: I'll prepare the eval runbook and a short checklist for getting Priya's 10k-record sample into a sandbox for embeddings. On the security side, Liu's KMS ask is likely an HSM/KMS key policy review — I'll draft a standard checklist and the docs we'll need to share (SOC 2 scope, data retention, and a short note on our private deployment KMS model).

I will also have a small performance smoke-test harness ready (100 queries, reference queries + expected latency/accuracy output) so we can run before the end of week 1.

If either of you want specific test prompts or a baseline embedding similarity rubric, tell me and I'll include it.
